$comment: The Birch family roster, as data. Birth dates only — never ages. Anything that needs an age computes it from the current date, so this file does not go stale on a birthday. Names and ids match src/config/family.ts; keep the ids identical, because the app's rotation schedule keys off them.
$timezoneNote: Rexburg, Idaho, which observes Mountain Time. Confirm before changing — the app's rotations and the AI's bedtime behaviour both read it.
